answer_4.quote: We use two crowdsourcing tasks to (1) prune unanswerable images, and (2) verify correctness of the labels.
answer_4.guideline: In the first task, we display a single image, and ask a worker to answer, without searching online, if any person can guess the time and location of the image. We offer different hierarchies in the choices -date, year, decade, and century for time and exact location, city, country, and continent for locationso that workers can choose one of these. The second task further verifies the correctness of current time and location labels. Specifically, we provide the same image, but including its caption, news headline, abstract, and extracted time and location labels. We ask the workers to verify if the background event is the same as in image, and if the labels are correct after reading the additional information.
